# Notebook Practical Operation Entry

This directory contains three types of Notebooks: execution templates, saved output teaching Notebooks, and end-to-end workflows that rely on upstream engineering and local models. Different types have different execution states.

## Pre-run Settings

```bash
export PROJECT_ROOT=/path/to/mujoco_pnp
export DATA_ROOT=/path/to/datasets/every_embodied
export MODEL_ROOT=/path/to/checkpoints/every_embodied
export RUN_ROOT=/path/to/runs/every_embodied
export OUTPUT_ROOT=$RUN_ROOT/notebooks

cd /path/to/04-AMD-ROCm策略复刻专题
jupyter lab
```

`PROJECT_ROOT` refers to the upstream MuJoCo project. Data, models, and output directories are placed outside the thematic repository.

The default switch for the end-to-end Notebook is off. When no upstream path is provided, the configuration and description unit can run, and the training and evaluation units will display the required variables.

## General Training and Protection Training

[workflows/README.md](workflows/README.md) provides separate copies of the regular training and protected training. Both types of experiments use different `$RUN_ROOT` subdirectories to evaluate the model generated during this training by reading the current Notebook.

## Re-execute

After installing the Jupyter kernel, use Jupyter's native execution first. When the teaching image lacks `nbclient`, a lightweight executor can be used to execute units without an interactive window:

```bash
python code/execute_tutorial_notebooks.py \
  notebooks/07_data_collection_and_audit.ipynb \
  notebooks/08_act_training_rocm.ipynb \
  notebooks/09_smolvla_training_rocm.ipynb \
  notebooks/10_pi0_training_rocm.ipynb \
  notebooks/11_mujoco_closed_loop_deploy.ipynb \
  notebooks/12_pi0_strict_input_end_to_end.ipynb \
  notebooks/13_pi05_random_position_eef_delta.ipynb
```

During long training, the progress bar is refreshed in the same output area; the step metrics are written into `metrics.jsonl`, avoiding the addition of a Notebook output block for each step.

## Acceptance

After completing the end-to-end process of a model, check:

1. The data, observations, and actions in the training configuration are consistent with those in the evaluation environment;
2. The evaluation model path is located at `checkpoints/` for this run;
3. The number of results per round matches the evaluation denominator in the configuration;
4. Success/failure videos are playable and allow locating the corresponding result row;
5. There are no abnormal outputs or private machine absolute paths in the Notebook.
